name: Aetheris
description: Aetheris are humanoids most easily recognized by their wings and sacred markings.
features: Hallowed Aura: Once per long rest when an ally within Close range rolls with Fear, you can change it into a roll with Hope instead.
Celestial Wings: You have wings that allow you to fly. Once per scene while flying, you can **spend a Hope** instead of marking an Armor Slot.

name: Earthkin
description: Earthkin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and earth.
features: Stoneskin: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Armor Score and damage thresholds at character creation.
Immovable: While you're touching the ground, you can't be lifted or moved against your will.

name: Emberkin
description: Emberkin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and fire.
features: Fireproof: You are immune to damage from magical or mundane flame.

Ignition: **Mark a Stress** to wreathe your primary weapon in flame until the end of the scene. While the weapon is ablaze, it gives off a bright light, and you gain a **1d6** bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

name: Gnome
description: Gnomes are typically small humanoids with conical heads and the ability to teleport short distances.
features: Nimble Fingers: When you make a Finesse Roll, you can **spend 2 Hope** to reroll your Hope Die.
Flicker Step: Once per scene, you can teleport to another point you can see within Far range.

name: Skykin
description: Skykin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and air.
features: Gale Force: **Mark a Stress** to conjure a gust of wind that carries you or a Very Close ally up to Very Far range. Additionally, you can always control the speed at which you fall.
Eye of the Storm: **Spend 2 Hope** to grant you or an ally within Melee range a +1 bonus to Evasion until you take Severe damage or you use this feature again.

name: Tidekin
description: Tidekin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and water.
features: Amphibious: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.
Lifespring: Once per rest when you have access to a small amount of water, you can **mark a Stress** to clear a Hit Point on yourself or an ally within Very Close range.
